name: Trap
overview: The Scriptures reveal that traps and snares symbolize the dangers and judgments that God allows to come upon His people when they turn from Him. In Joshua 23:13, unremoved nations become snares and traps, leading to Israel's downfall if they disobey. Job 18:10 describes traps as hidden dangers laid in the way, illustrating the unseen perils that can ensnare a person. Jeremiah 5:26 warns that wicked men set traps to catch others, highlighting the active schemes of evil that threaten the faithful. Together, these verses teach believers to be vigilant against spiritual and moral pitfalls that can lead to destruction.
